testcase.name: only an https address with a host is a source
an rss 1 document is read too
a switched-off source, a stale headline and a repeated story are left out
a json feed is read
a bare json array of headlines with unix times is read
rss dates are read in their many spellings
an item with nothing to print is dropped and the rest still show
an atom feed's entries are headlines, and its link is an attribute
an html page is refused rather than read as an empty feed
the source list survives the round trip through preferences
markup and double-escaped entities are not printed at the viewer
the encoding the declaration names is the one the document is read in
one busy source cannot push the others off the screen
a time with a zone this reader does not know is read as local time
the parsed headlines survive the round trip through preferences
a source is called by its own name without the slogan, or by its host
an rss channel names the source and its items are the headlines
an empty document is an empty source, not an error
a bare clock time is the most recent time the clock read it
every source's headlines become one column, newest first, each with its source's colour
nonsense is no date rather than a wrong one
